posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
Hello there, please consider reading through
this post
and provide more details. Particularly a screenshot of the event you have attempted to create will make it easier to point out what you're missing.
By the way, the door looks to be about one tile wide, so you could also tweak the sprite sheet so that it is centered on a single tile? In any case, there's numerous ways to solve the issue. Probably the most straightforward would be to have an empty event next to the door that does the same thing (NINJA'D by
@utunnels
lol).
How to best do that depends on what you wish to accomplish with the event. Does the door swing open? Or is it just a transfer?
